paragraphs: VirTra sells immersive simulation training that prepares law enforcement, military, and public-safety professionals to make better decisions under pressure. The line covers single-screen, multi-screen, and headset simulators with extensive branching options. Drop-in service weapon recoil kits and less lethal devices let trainees use the tools they carry on the job.

Beyond police, the site lists military warfighters, prison and jail officers, courtroom security, healthcare workers, classroom use, and church security groups. VirTra states simulators are in over 500 agencies nationwide. The company also cites over 1000 realistic training scenarios delivered and reach in more than 40 countries.

NCP-certified curriculum comes free with every simulator. VirTra is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company and says 16% of employees are veterans and retired law enforcement. In August 2026 VirTra announced a $1.5M sole-source contract from the U.S. Army to support firearms training in Tajikistan.

quote.text: VirTra’s Mission is to save lives by developing, manufacturing and supporting the most powerful and immersive training simulators, scenarios and accessories worldwide.
